<b>Pebb</b> is a [[NPCs (Silksong)#Merchants|Merchant]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. She is an old pilgrim who sells wares at her shop in [[Bone Bottom]] in exchange for [[Rosaries]].<ref>Pebb: <i>"O-oh! Traveller! Destined for the Citadel, yes? Well, before you embark, won't you stop and make trade with an old pilgrim?"</i></ref>

== Background ==
Pebb is one of the many pilgrims who arrived in Bone Bottom to start her pilgrimage to [[the Citadel]]. She sells off her wares for Rosaries, as she believes they will aid her on the journey ahead.<ref>Pebb: <i>"I'll soon be making my way up to the great Citadel. As holy as I am with rosaries, I'm sure my path will not be an arduous one..."</i></ref><ref>Haunted Pebb [[Needolin]] dialogue: <i>"O shining beads! Blessed am I... Guide my ascent... O holy gleam!"</i></ref>

== In-Game Events ==
Pebb is the first merchant encountered in [[Pharloom]]. She offers to trade with [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], and if the latter has not yet met [[Shakra]], explains the currency of this kingdom, [[Rosaries]].<ref>Hornet and Pebb dialogue: <br><i>Pebb: "O-oh! Traveller! Destined for the Citadel, yes? Well, before you embark, won't you stop and make trade with an old pilgrim?"<br>Hornet: "I'd see your wares, madam, though I fear I may have nothing worthy to offer in return."<br>Pebb: "Oh, worry not! If you lack fine goods to trade, we can barter still. In this devout land, we deal in the currency of faith! Rosaries! Those finely carved beads of prayer! If you will only share some with me, I will trade you something fair."</i></ref>

After the [[Skull Tyrant]] attack, she wonders how such beasts can infest the path to their paradise, and asks Hornet to trade, as she needs more Rosaries to brave such a world.<ref>Pebb: <i>"Oh, oh dear... what fearful events are sent to test we poor pilgrims! How could it be that our path to paradise is infested with such beasts? To brave such a world... oh my. I'll need more rosaries, that's for certain. Please traveller, won't you trade with me?"</i></ref>

Once Hornet buys all of her stock (excluding the renewable [[Rosary String]]), Pebb decides to close the shop and begin her pilgrimage, as she has no more excuses to linger in Bone Bottom.<ref>Pebb: <i>"Well now! Seems I've traded you the last of my supplies, so I've got no more excuses to linger down here."</i></ref> Her tent disappears once Hornet visits town again after resting on a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] elsewhere.

She can later be found as an enemy [[Haunting|haunted]] by Silk in the easternmost room of [[the Marrow]] that connects it to the [[Deep Docks]]. As an enemy, she is nearly indistinguishable from a [[Pilgrim Pouncer]], but can be identified by her unique [[Needolin]] dialogue, her merchant bag lying nearby, and {{R|55}} she drops upon defeat.

Pebb vanishes once Bone Bottom is destroyed after the start of [[Act 3]], and any unpurchased goods are taken and sold by [[Grindle]].

== Location ==
Pebb can first be found in [[Bone Bottom]], to the left of the [[wishwall]]. After leaving Bone Bottom, she appears as an enemy in [[the Marrow]].
